purpose: Estimate benefit of eliminating redundant metric-name-drop aggregation by manual SQL on unpatched ClickHouse
query: SELECT sumForEach(values) FROM (SELECT timeSeriesRateToGrid(start,end,step,range)(samples) AS values FROM timeSeriesSelector('default','bench_ts_50k','bench_metric',start_minus_window,end,'samples') GROUP BY timeSeriesIdToGroup(id))
limitations: This is not the compiled C++ fastpath patch. Manual SQL may not match the patched planner exactly.

Manual timing excludes final timeSeriesFromGrid materialization and JSON rows; array output is 1 KB vs native 2.7 KB. HTTP output differences are minor at this response size but must be accounted for.
Other workloads present in shared container; compare with A/B interleaving for stronger controls.
Per-series grid materialization and selector cost remain, so the intended patch does not guarantee parity with VictoriaMetrics.
Verify handling of missing data, counters with resets, empty selectors, and identical label sets across multiple series IDs before using manual SQL broadly.
